setup_cmd: curl -sSL https://developer.arm.com/-/media/Files/downloads/gnu/13.2.rel1/binrel/arm-gnu-toolchain-13.2.rel1-x86_64-arm-none-eabi.tar.xz | tar -xJ -C "$RUNNER_TEMP" && echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/arm-gnu-toolchain-13.2.Rel1-x86_64-arm-none-eabi/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH" && pip install "cmake~=3.29.0" cbor2 click "cryptography>=42.0" gitpython intelhex python-dotenv "bitstring==4.2" pyserial regex crcmod "memfault-cli==1.0"
build_cmd: git submodule update --init && git submodule update --init --recursive src/lib/bm_core src/lib/bm_serial && rm -rf cmake-build-membrowse && cmake -B cmake-build-membrowse -DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE=$PWD/cmake/arm-none-eabi-gcc.cmake -DBSP=bridge_v1_0 -DAPP=bridge -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DUSE_BOOTLOADER=1 && cmake --build cmake-build-membrowse -j$(nproc) --target bridge_v1_0-bridge.elf
